claims.claim: Zebra Q2 2026 net sales rose 20.4% to $1.557B, with 9.2% organic growth and growth across both Connected Frontline and Asset Visibility & Automation.
Management raised the full-year outlook and links demand to automation, intelligent operations and frontline AI adoption.

risks.risk: Reported growth includes meaningful acquisition/disposition and FX effects; organic growth is materially lower than reported growth.

unknowns.unknown: Persistence of current demand and acquisition contribution into 2027 remains prospective.

claims.claim: Q2 adjusted EBITDA rose 61.4% to $431M and adjusted EBITDA margin reached 27.7% versus 20.6% a year earlier.
Zebra now expects full-year 2026 sales growth of 14%-16%, adjusted EBITDA margin of 23.5%-24.0%, non-GAAP EPS of $20.75-$21.25 and free cash flow above $1B.
First-half operating cash flow was $387M and free cash flow $361M, while share repurchases totaled $568M; total debt was $2.776B at July 4.

risks.risk: Tariff recoveries and favorable FX contributed to margin expansion, while debt and acquisition integration remain execution sensitivities.

contradictions.contradiction: Record margins include $73M of IEEPA tariff recoveries, so the full magnitude of margin expansion should not be treated as purely underlying operating improvement.

unknowns.unknown: Sustainability of margin gains after tariff-recovery effects normalize remains uncertain.
